svg.text: User searches by artist / genre; app sends a find-music request

Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Load balancer picks a web server (balanced on network bandwidth / open streams, not just CPU)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Web server runs a relational query (genre, artist) and returns ~100 song rows; the MP3 store is never touched

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: App asks the web server to play a song id

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Server looks up the audio link in the metadata DB

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Server reads the whole ~5 MB file from S3 into memory (small enough, avoids streaming lag from the DB)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Server streams chunks to the app; frequently played songs are cached on the phone

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Web servers track recent request counts; when a song gets hot they tell the CDN to pull it

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: CDN fetches the file from S3 once instead of 10M origin reads

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Later requests get a redirect (or a CDN check) and stream from the nearest edge, cutting load on web servers and S3

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • 1B users, 100M songs, ~5 MB/song → ~500 TB raw, ~1.5 PB with 3x replication; metadata only ~10-100 GB, user data ~1 TB

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Two stores because access patterns differ: immutable blobs (S3) vs queried/updated rows (RDS)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Cache layers: phone → CDN edge → web-server memory → S3. Geo-aware replication keeps regional music near its listeners
